description: This file is a shell script containing tests for git svn properties functionality. It sets up a test environment, performs svn operations, and verifies svn property setting and retrieval using git-svn commands.

methods.name: set_props
methods.description: Sets multiple svn properties on a specified file within a subdirectory, then commits the changes with a message 'testing propset'.

methods.name: confirm_props
methods.description: Confirms that specified svn properties have the expected values on a file within a subdirectory.
